newsitem.title: UK: Copper just firmer in late London.
newsitem.headline: Copper just firmer in late London.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three months delivery copper was just firmer from the kerb close by the time COMEX ended at 1900 GMT.
Thin late inter-office activity saw copper ease from last kerb business at $2,345 per tonne towards nearby support at $2,330 before it rebounded to stand bid at $2,359 by the time of the COMEX close.
Copper had slipped in earlier LME trading after failing at overhead resistance and an unsurprising 3,050-tonne stock fall.
